task: FV2-040 — Responsive client update banner on desktop
summary: A user-provided Windows screenshot showed the long release summary wrapping into a very tall, underlined column and pushing the workspace below the fold. The Flutter update banner now clamps its summary to two lines with ellipsis and explicitly disables text decoration; full release details remain available in the existing details sheet. Package-version fallback defaults and all native platform build identities were synchronized with 1.0.35+68/r49. After the user approved recovery, android-v1.0.35 was retargeted to fb22c2c7 and the signed APK release was published successfully.

checks.name: Test-first desktop geometry regression
checks.observation: Before the fix, the new regression failed because maxLines was null. After the fix, a 1280×900 desktop layout at text scale 2.5 has a two-line summary, no text decoration, banner height below 220 px, and no Flutter exception.
